data.name: Ramiya
data.gender_notes: Ramiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ramiya is an Arabic name for girls and boys which means beautiful, graceful. It is derived from the word ramy which means throwing, casting or shooting an arrow. Ramiya, therefore, suggests someone who throws, casts or shoots something with grace and beauty. The name Ramiya carries the meaning “Beautiful, Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramiya usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be spiritually graceful and beautiful in one's actions and deeds.
data.etymology: Ramiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramiya total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رامية
in_arabic.meaning: رامية تعني القاذفة أو الرامية بالقوس
in_arabic.long_meaning: رامية هي اسم عربي مؤنث، مشتق من الفعل 'رامى' والذي يعني القذف أو الرمي بالقوس. في اللغة العربية، تحمل كلمة 'رامية' معنى القاذفة أو الرامية، سواء كانت تستخدم القوس أو غيره من أدوات الرمي. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بالشجاعة والمهارة في التعامل مع الأسلحة القذفية. كما أن الاسم يحمل دلالات القوة والقدرة على الإنجاز.

in_urdu.name: رامیہ
in_urdu.meaning: رامیہ کا مطلب ہے تیر انداز یا قاذف
in_urdu.long_meaning: رامیہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے تیر انداز یا قاذف۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے فعل 'رامى' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے تیر اندازی کرنا یا قذف کرنا۔ اسلامی روایات میں، تیر اندازی کو ایک قابل ستائش فن اور جنگ میں اہم ہنر کے طور پر شمار کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس نام کا انتخاب اس بات کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے کہ والدین اپنے بچے میں شجاعت، درستگی اور قوت ارادی جیسی خوبیاں پیدا کرنا چاہتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रामिया
in_hindi.meaning: रामिया का अर्थ है धनुर्धारी या प्रक्षेपक
in_hindi.long_meaning: रामिया एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है धनुर्धारी या प्रक्षेपक। यह नाम अरबी क्रिया 'रामى' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है तीर चलाना या प्रक्षेपण करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, तीर चलाना एक प्रशंसनीय कौशल माना जाता है और युद्ध में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है। यह नाम शक्ति, सटीकता और आत्म-बलिदान जैसे गुणों का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: رامیه
in_pashto.meaning: رامیه د تیر اندازۍ یا قاذفۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: رامیه د عربي نوم څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د تیر اندازۍ یا قاذفۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'رامى' کلمې څخه مشتق شوی دی، چې د تیر اندازۍ یا قذف کولو معنی لري. په پښتني کلتور کې، تیر اندازي د پښتنو د تاريخي او قومي فخر څخه شمشال دی. دا نوم د زړورتیا، مهارت او دقت څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Ramiya
in_english.meaning: Ramiya means archer or thrower, symbolizing strength and precision
in_english.long_meaning: Ramiya is an Arabic name derived from the root 'r-m-y', which means to throw or cast, particularly with a bow. In Islamic tradition, archery is considered a noble skill and a significant aspect of martial prowess. The name Ramiya, therefore, embodies qualities of bravery, accuracy, and resilience. Historically, archery has been a respected skill in many Muslim cultures, reflecting the importance of defense and strategic warfare. The name is also associated with positive attributes such as focus, determination, and the ability to achieve goals with precision.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ramiya has been popular across various Islamic communities, despite its origins being Arabic. Its beauty and elegance appeal to parents who want to give their child a name that not only sounds pleasing but also holds a profound meaning. Furthermore, the significance of throwing an arrow with grace and beauty aligns with various Islamic stories and traditions, such as the Prophet Mohammad's (PBUH) archery skills and his teachings on both physical and moral prowess.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ramiya can be seen as symbolizing various aspects of personal growth and development. It suggests the idea of aiming high and shooting arrows towards one's goals with grace and beauty. Moreover, the Arabic root of the name, ramy, can be linked to the concept of 'ramada' in the holy month of Ramadan. Just as one must fast and practice self-discipline during this month, the name Ramiya can serve as a reminder to aim for spiritual growth and cast arrows towards Allah (SWT) with grace and beauty in every aspect of one's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: A symbol of compassion and nurturing, Ramiya is a name that evokes the gentle touch of a caring mother, providing comfort and solace in times of need. It is a reminder of the divine mercy and love that surrounds us, offering strength and resilience in the face of adversity.
